text:
Maria Chen: started a canary rollout of terraform module gpupool v2.9.0 — plan surfaced a KMS IAM diff referencing role 'projects/redwood-prod/roles/RedwoodKMSAdmin' that doesn't exist in staging. apply failed partway. @Derek can you take a look?
CI-Bot: terraform plan for modules/gpupool completed with errors: 
```
Error: google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding already exists (conflict)
  on modules/gpupool/main.tf line 112, in resource \"google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding\":
  112: resource \"google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding\" \"binding\" {

Resource exists in state but under a different module path.
```
Derek Liu: on it. v2.9.0 included an input rename (kms_binding_name -> kms_service_account) and an optional auto-create role, looks like the canary hit a case where the role is absent. if we upgraded without a mapping we get drift. recommend revert to v2.8.7 for now.
Maria Chen: :eyes: reverting the PR now (github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1448). can we hotfix the module to accept the old binding name and create the role if missing? would avoid manual steps during rollout.
Samir Patel: quick heads-up — us-west1 is tight. the plan wanted to add 4 A100s in us-west1 and GCP returned insufficient capacity for preemptible A100s. apply timed out waiting for instance group creation. might be unrelated to KMS but blocked the canary.
April Torres: small cost reminder: v2.9 forced additional KMS ops for encrypted cache rotation; at our scale that could add ~\$0.02 per KMS op — finance wants a quick estimate before prod.
infra-oncall: if the apply was partial, you may have orphaned state entries. run `terraform state list | grep gpupool` and `terraform state rm module.gpupool.google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.binding` if needed before reapplying. also check remote state lock.
Maria Chen: CI-Bot shows gitops sync stuck: argocd flagged gpupool/namespace as 'Health: Unknown' after partial apply. Samir, can you check the cluster's node autoscaler + event logs?
Samir Patel: looking. node autoscaler is fine, but GKE is reporting 'insufficient cpus' in us-west1-b. i've filed a quota increase with GCP (case 0123456789), ETA ~2h. for the canary we can flip to europe-west1 to validate the KMS behavior while us-west quota is pending.
Derek Liu: proposed plan: 1) revert infra PR 1448 to unblock staging; 2) open module patch with backwards-compatible shim + migration docs; 3) run a small canary in europe-west1 to validate KMS binding creation and state import behavior; 4) add a `terraform import` step in the rollout CI to prevent orphan re-creation.
CI-Bot: action items created: infra-1449 (revert PR), infra-1450 (module-shim patch), infra-1451 (eu-west1 canary). assigned to Derek Liu and Maria Chen. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: thanks — i'll push the revert and add notes to the rollout runbook: do NOT auto-pin gpupool module via dependabot until shim lands. will update this thread with the revert commit and canary outcome.
